analysis.description: A pyramid-shaped stone building with a large spiral pattern on its sloping roof stands behind a neat lawn and wide steps. A tall coconut palm leans across the right side of the frame against a clear blue sky. Blue banners by the entrance and a small footwear stand hint at a quiet, welcoming space.
analysis.setting: meditation centre grounds with lawn and stone steps on a sunny day
analysis.subject: Pyramid meditation hall with spiral roof

analysis.description: A tabby cat with green eyes lies stretched out on a patterned tiled pavement, head raised and gazing straight into the lens. The background is softly blurred into warm brown tones with a dark round shape at the top edge.
analysis.subject: a stray tabby cat lying on a tiled pavement

analysis.description: Mist drifts over a forested hill, softening the treeline into a pale grey sky. Dark green trees fill the foreground, with small clusters of yellow flowers at the bottom edge and a leafy branch on the right.
analysis.setting: forested hillside on a misty morning
analysis.subject: Misty forested hillside

analysis.description: Green forested hills rise behind a belt of trees and a few low rooftops, with a red and white mobile tower standing on the right. Heavy grey clouds fill the upper frame and soft light keeps everything muted and still.
analysis.setting: hill foothills on an overcast morning
analysis.subject: Forested hills under overcast sky

analysis.description: A male Indian peafowl stands side-on on a grassy bank, its head turned toward the camera with the small crest lifted. The deep blue neck and green body stand out against the soft green bamboo and shrubs behind, and the barred wing pattern is sharp and detailed. The train trails low behind it, close to the ground.
analysis.setting: grassy forest edge with bamboo and scrub
analysis.subject: Indian peacock standing on grass

analysis.description: A richly decorated festival pandal frames a large multi-armed goddess idol under a golden arch, with smaller idols on either side. A small sacred fire burns in front among offerings, garlands and marigolds, and a band of fresh flowers runs along the red curtain above.
analysis.subject: Durga idol in festival pandal

analysis.description: A wide, low-angle view of a bar where the ceiling is built from huge glowing stone-like blocks carved with faint hieroglyph patterns. Warm light spills through the textured blocks against a black night sky. Bartenders stand behind a curved, polished counter with shelves of bottles glowing behind them.
analysis.setting: rooftop bar with an ancient-temple inspired interior
analysis.subject: glowing stone-block bar ceiling

analysis.description: A many-armed Ganesha idol stands in a pandal framed by red and white pleated drapes, with a pink-lit ceiling and a small flower chandelier overhead. Garlands hang beside the idol and the dark night surrounds the bright stage. The symmetrical framing draws the eye straight to the idol's face.
analysis.subject: Ganesha idol in decorated pandal

analysis.description: A black and white cat with green eyes lies on red earth between thin tree trunks, looking off to the side. A terracotta-coloured wall and a white pipe sit softly behind it, and bare branches cross the frame in front.
analysis.setting: shaded garden corner beside a textured red wall
analysis.subject: Black and white cat resting under shrubs

analysis.description: A tall multi-storey mall atrium seen from a balcony, with curved white walkways stacking up toward a black steel and glass roof. A climbing wall with orange and blue panels sits in the centre, and small shoppers move along the levels around it. The symmetrical lines and warm shop lights pull the eye upward.
analysis.subject: mall atrium with glass roof

analysis.description: Layers of forested hills fade into a pale hazy sky, with the nearest tree canopy in deeper green on the right. Thin power lines cross the lower left, and the haze gives the scene a soft, quiet depth.
analysis.subject: misty forested hills

analysis.description: A wide view from a hill road looks down over a hazy plain of fields and distant hills, under a sky full of soft white clouds. Thin vertical wires of a tall fence run across the whole frame, with one grey post on the left. Green grass, trees and a rocky green hillock fill the lower half.
analysis.setting: hill road with a view over the plains
analysis.subject: hilltop view through a wire fence

analysis.description: A tall, multi-armed Ganesha idol stands in a dancing pose inside a festival pandal, draped in colourful flower garlands and a gold crown. White fabric swirls across the ceiling with a hanging cascade of white wisteria-like flowers and a chandelier, while cream curtains and maroon drapes frame the figure.
analysis.subject: Ganesha idol in pandal

analysis.description: A quiet two-lane road runs toward a forested hill softened by morning haze. Dry golden grass and a lone tree line the roadside, with power lines stretching across a pale, misty sky.
analysis.subject: empty road through hazy hills

analysis.description: A long exposure captures a tall, flowing column of fire rising from a small glowing base on dark, dusty ground. Smoke curls at the top and tiny sparks drift around the scene. The warm amber light stands out sharply against the black night.
analysis.subject: A long-exposure flame rising from a glowing object on the ground at night

analysis.description: A single yellow marigold on a tall stem stands in front of a window beaded with raindrops. Behind it, city lights melt into soft golden and blue bokeh. The dark green feathery leaves are sharp in the foreground.
analysis.setting: balcony or window ledge on a rainy evening
analysis.subject: Marigold against a rainy window at night

analysis.description: A tall, multi-storey café seen from an upper balcony, with a dark corrugated ceiling, steel staircases and big glass windows. Orange pendant lamps glow against the black beams, and potted plants climb the railings with a leafy tree visible outside. Wooden tables and pink chairs sit empty below, with a projector screen on the right.
analysis.setting: industrial-style café with glass walls and indoor plants
analysis.subject: multi-level café interior

analysis.description: Layers of forested hills fade into a soft morning haze under a pale grey sky. A pale, rocky cliff face stands out in the middle of the range, with trees and dry grass in the foreground.
analysis.setting: hill country with forest and open scrub
analysis.subject: misty forested hills with a pale rocky cliff

analysis.description: A tall festival display made of thousands of LED lights shows a goddess holding a trident, seated beside a glowing lion, framed by blue, orange and red halos. It stands against a dark night sky with strings of warm lights hanging at the edge and leaves in the foreground.
analysis.subject: Lit-up goddess and lion display

analysis.description: A small terracotta oil lamp sits in a dark, grainy surface, with its wick burning and a tall warm flame rising from the rim. The light glows on the clay and the pale oil around the wick, and the rest of the frame falls into deep brown shadow.
analysis.setting: dim indoor corner, lit by one flame
analysis.subject: A lit clay diya with a flame rising from its wick

analysis.description: Magenta bougainvillea bracts glow with sunlight coming through their papery petals, showing fine veins. Thorny brown branches cross the frame, and a soft blur of green and more pink flowers fills the background.
analysis.setting: garden or roadside bougainvillea bush in late afternoon light
analysis.subject: Backlit bougainvillea blooms

analysis.description: A huge dark cylindrical linga rises from a tiered square base, each level marked with three white horizontal stripes and a small red-and-gold diamond. A pale hazy evening sky sits behind it, and a tiny white shrine at the bottom edge shows how large the structure is.
analysis.subject: Giant black Shiva linga monument

analysis.description: A rounded, earth-toned cottage with a red clay tile roof and a small covered porch with an arched door. A tall chimney-like tower rises on the left, and green trees and a pine tree stand behind under a soft cloudy sky. Raised planter beds and dry leaves sit in the foreground.
analysis.subject: Terracotta cottage with tiled roof

analysis.description: A large Ferris wheel glows against a black night sky, its spokes traced in zigzag neon lines of pink, blue, green, orange and white. Small gondolas ring the rim and string lights twinkle near the base of the fair ground.
analysis.subject: Illuminated Ferris wheel at night

analysis.description: A pale, glowing sun hangs in a warm peach haze above layered hills. Palm trees and dark shrubs in the foreground fade into silhouette as the light softens.
analysis.subject: hazy sun over hills at dusk

analysis.description: A clay oil lamp burns on a brick-paved path after dark, its flame leaning over a wick that floats in warm oil. The warm glow lights the bowl and the worn bricks around it, while the rest of the frame falls into shadow.
analysis.subject: Lit clay diya oil lamp on a brick path at night

analysis.description: A firecracker burns bright at the end of a thin stick, throwing a spray of glowing sparks and a cloud of lit smoke against a dark background. Long streaks of light trail off to the left, and a thin fuse hangs below the flame.
analysis.subject: A lit firecracker throwing sparks and smoke at night

analysis.description: A single orange-and-yellow rose seen from above, its layered petals opening toward a cluster of golden stamens at the centre. Soft green leaves and dark foliage blur into the background, letting the flower hold the frame.
analysis.subject: orange rose in bloom

analysis.description: An orange and white cat stretches with its front paws forward and tail curled up, standing on the stone edge of a swimming pool. Its reflection ripples in the blue tiled water below, and a pink wall with a round lamp post sits behind it.
analysis.setting: swimming pool edge with a pink wall and garden greenery
analysis.subject: Orange and white cat stretching by a pool

analysis.description: A single firework or firecracker has just burst on bare ground, throwing a bright orange flame and a billowing column of smoke up into the dark. Thin glowing sparks and curling trails of light scatter across the whole frame, caught in a long exposure.
analysis.subject: A firecracker burst on dark ground at night, with flame, smoke and sparks rising

analysis.description: A stepped yellow platform at a temple is lined with rows of small black shivalingas, repeating in a neat pyramid. Golden carved pillars and a grey stone wall rise behind, with a leafy branch and soft blue sky on the left. The late light is warm and the stone courtyard is quiet.
analysis.subject: Rows of black shivalingas on yellow steps

analysis.description: A large, puffy white cumulus cloud rises from the bottom of the frame against a deep blue sky. The cloud's edges are soft and sculpted, with grey shading in the folds giving it depth. The upper sky is a clean, smooth blue with plenty of empty space.
analysis.setting: open sky on a clear afternoon
analysis.subject: Billowing white cumulus cloud

analysis.description: A tall bank of white cumulus clouds lit warm by low evening light rises behind a dark, tree-covered hill. The pale blue sky fills the upper half of the frame, and dry golden patches of foliage dot the hillside below.
analysis.subject: Cumulus clouds over a forested hill

analysis.description: A single bright cloud lit from below by city light rises behind the leafy branches of a tree. The rest of the night sky is dark and grey with faint wisps of cloud. The green leaves stand out against the pale cloud.
analysis.setting: roadside tree under a night sky in the city
analysis.subject: Glowing cloud behind a tree

analysis.description: A tall stepped wall of backlit, textured blocks glows amber against a deep navy sky above a busy rooftop bar. Silhouetted diners and bartenders fill the bottom of the frame, with round lamps dotting the edges.
analysis.subject: glowing stepped wall at rooftop bar

analysis.description: A large black Nandi statue seen from behind faces a giant Shivalinga as the sun sets behind a dark cloud, sending soft rays across the sky. A few visitors walk along the temple courtyard in the distance, behind a steel railing.
analysis.subject: Nandi statue and Shivalinga at sunset

analysis.description: A single coral-peach rose opens at the centre of the frame, its layered petals curling softly around a tight bud heart. Dark green foliage blurs into the background, and a small cluster of reddish new leaves sits at the upper left.
analysis.subject: peach-coral rose in bloom

analysis.description: Three pink water lilies rise from a dark, still pond covered with broad green lily pads. Two open blooms stand tall on the left and centre while a third, half-open bud sits low on the right, and their reflections ripple faintly in the water.
analysis.subject: pink water lilies on a dark pond among floating leaves

analysis.description: A hazy morning field of tall wind-bent grass, with a cluster of white feathery plumes in the middle distance. Trees and low scrub fade into pale grey sky at the back, and a dusty gold patch of harvested field runs across the middle.
analysis.setting: open field at the edge of a village, early morning
analysis.subject: misty grassland with white feathery grass at dawn

analysis.description: A close view of a decorated Durga idol with many arms holding weapons, framed by sequined peacock-style motifs and a red veil. Marigold and mixed flower garlands hang across the chest, and a deep red velvet curtain fills the background. The colours are rich and the sequins catch the light.
analysis.subject: Durga idol at festival pandal

analysis.description: A quiet café corner with an exposed red brick wall, three black-and-white cocktail prints and teal benches. Rust-orange velvet chairs sit at dark tables on a wood-plank floor, while tall windows let in green treetop light.
analysis.subject: café interior with brick wall

analysis.description: Red onion-shaped domes and carved stone towers of a grand palace glow against a dark night sky. Warm yellow light spills from the arched windows, and a bright lamp on the left throws soft starburst rays. Tiny birds dot the facade, adding a small living detail to the heritage stonework.
analysis.subject: Illuminated palace domes at night

analysis.description: A framed image of a multi-armed goddess sits inside a shrine decorated with a beaded golden arch, red fabric and heaps of white, yellow and purple flowers. A small flame flickers in the foreground, adding warm light and movement. The frame is dense with colour and texture.
analysis.subject: decorated goddess idol with flowers and flame

analysis.description: A cluster of pale pink trumpet flowers with magenta throats rises on a green stem, with heart-shaped leaves lit from behind so the veins glow. The background is a soft, dark green blur, and the warm low sun gives the scene a quiet morning feel.
analysis.subject: pink morning glory flowers on a green vine in warm backlight

analysis.description: Three terracotta pots sit on a black tiered stand and on the floor of a small balcony at dusk, with a marigold bud on top. A glass railing frames a deep blue sky and blurred apartment lights beyond. The scene is quiet and tidy, with warm terracotta against cool blue.
analysis.subject: potted plants on a balcony

analysis.description: A bronze-toned relief of a reclining Buddha rests his head on one hand, eyes softly closed, surrounded by carved lotus flowers and leaves. Carved wooden pillars frame the top of the scene against a dark wall. The textures of the metal, drapery and petals fill the frame.
analysis.setting: carved relief in a temple or monastery interior
analysis.subject: Reclining Buddha relief

analysis.description: A richly decorated festival pandal shows a central multi-armed goddess idol flanked by two smaller idols, all framed by layered golden crowns and arches. Gold ornaments, flower garlands and a deep maroon backdrop fill the frame, with fresh flowers hanging along the top edge.
analysis.setting: festival pandal during a temple celebration
analysis.subject: Ornate festival goddess idols

analysis.description: A cone firework is burning on a dusty ground at night, throwing a bright column of orange flame, sparks and drifting smoke. The light falls on the rough soil around it, and the dark edges make the fire the clear focus.
analysis.subject: firework fountain burning on the ground

analysis.description: Polished wooden picnic-style tables and benches sit on a damp deck outside a white wall with a black arched shuttered window. A street lamp glows against a deep blue night sky, and pink buildings and a bright flowering tree sit in the background. Shadows and reflections stretch across the wet boards.
analysis.setting: outdoor café patio at night after rain
analysis.subject: wooden picnic tables on a wet patio

analysis.description: Tiered shelves of glass bottles glow against a warm, backlit wall carved to look like Egyptian hieroglyphs. Skull-shaped and ceramic decanters sit among rows of spirits, with glasses stacked on the left. The amber light gives the whole corner a theatrical, temple-like feel.
analysis.setting: themed bar interior with Egyptian-style carved wall
analysis.subject: backlit bar shelves with bottles

analysis.description: A narrow stream winds through open fields where tall, feathery white grass glows in soft haze. Scattered trees and a dark, wooded hill line sit under a pale, misty sky, giving the scene a quiet early-morning feel.
analysis.setting: open countryside by a stream, hill edge
analysis.subject: A narrow stream running between fields of white feathery grass, with hazy hills behind

analysis.description: A near-full moon sits in the centre of a deep black sky, its grey craters and bright highlands clearly visible. Faint wisps of cloud drift around it, softening the darkness. The framing is simple and quiet, with plenty of empty space around the moon.
analysis.subject: Full moon in a dark sky

analysis.description: A waxing gibbous moon sits in the middle of a clear, deep blue daytime sky. Soft grey craters and maria are visible on its pale surface, with the lit edge glowing gently against the blue. The frame is simple and minimal, with no clouds or other elements.
analysis.subject: Daytime waxing gibbous moon

analysis.description: A nearly full moon sits in the middle of a dark, cloudy sky, with its craters and grey seas clearly visible. Soft clouds drift around it, and one upper edge is dimmed by shadow. The black frame around it makes the moon feel small and quiet.
analysis.subject: Moon behind thin clouds

analysis.description: A slender green stem rises through the frame, lined with tiny pale purple and white flowers and round green buds. The background is a soft, creamy blur of warm browns and beiges, so the delicate petals stand out sharply. A second blurred plant sits at the lower left edge.
analysis.setting: scrubby patch of ground outdoors in dappled daylight
analysis.subject: Small purple flower spike

analysis.description: A cream and gold rooster stands on short grass in front of a thick, deeply grooved tree trunk, its red comb and wattle the brightest spot in the frame. Its white tail feathers curve up with a dark sweep at the tip, and long curved spurs show on its legs. Dry twigs and fallen leaves are scattered around, and the light is soft and even.
analysis.setting: grassy park or farm ground under a large tree
analysis.subject: Rooster beside a tree trunk

analysis.description: A peacock with a deep blue neck stands on a fallen log, looking toward the camera. Misty green forest fills the background. At the lower right, a spotted deer with antlers peeks out from the undergrowth, and more spotted deer are faintly visible behind the log.
analysis.setting: misty forest clearing in a wildlife reserve
analysis.subject: Peacock on a fallen branch

analysis.description: A grassy hillside slopes down toward a darker green ridge, with hazy plains stretching far into the distance. Big white clouds fill a blue sky. Thin wire fence lines run across the frame, adding a gentle grid over the view.
analysis.subject: green hills behind a wire fence

analysis.description: The crown of a bare-branched tree is covered in clusters of bright red flowers, lit so the thin twigs glow a dusky pink. The sky behind is a flat, dark grey-green, which makes the reds stand out sharply. Leaves at the bottom add a little dark green.
analysis.setting: tree-lined street or park at dusk
analysis.subject: Flowering tree against dark sky

analysis.description: A waxing gibbous moon fills most of the frame against a pure black sky. The dark maria and the rough crater texture along the lit edge are clearly visible, with the shadowed left side fading into the dark.
analysis.subject: Waxing gibbous moon

analysis.description: A high-angle view into a sunlit open-air café courtyard with arched white pillars, wrought-iron balconies and a tiered stone fountain at the centre. Red and green croton plants and trailing ivy fill the foreground, while tan shade sails stretch across the top of the frame. Tables sit mostly empty on a warm wooden floor, with a few diners on the upper and side levels.
analysis.subject: Courtyard café with fountain

analysis.description: A small yellow daisy-like flower lies face-forward on a dark, brushed surface, its thin petals fanned out around a textured orange centre. The background is softly blurred, and a thin green stem trails off behind the bloom. The bright yellow stands out strongly against the dark tones.
analysis.setting: flower resting on a dark tabletop indoors
analysis.subject: Yellow wildflower on a dark surface

analysis.description: A dark stone Nandi bull statue rises against a pale blue evening sky, its horns, beaded necklace and bell carved in fine detail. Two small green parakeets perch on one horn and on the hump, adding a tiny touch of life and colour. A white sacred mark sits on the forehead.
analysis.setting: open-air temple statue against a clear sky
analysis.subject: Black Nandi bull statue with parakeets

analysis.description: A small firework burns on bare ground at night, throwing a fountain of bright sparks and thin glowing trails upward. Smoke rises through the frame and the ground around the base is speckled with embers.
analysis.subject: a ground firework throwing sparks and smoke into the dark

analysis.description: Two spotted deer graze on a patch of dry grass scattered with fallen leaves and small stones, one in front with its head lowered and the other behind it. Tall trees fill the background, and a blurred red post in the left foreground frames the scene like a peek from behind a corner.
analysis.setting: forest clearing near a park or reserve
analysis.subject: Two spotted deer grazing

analysis.description: A small terracotta diya sits on a dark, rough stone surface, its cotton wick burning with a single warm flame. The light falls only on the lamp and the nearby ground, leaving the rest of the frame in deep shadow.
analysis.setting: dark floor at night, indoors or in a courtyard
analysis.subject: A lit clay diya with a cotton wick on a dark textured surface

analysis.description: A dark, heavy cloud fills the frame with its edges glowing gold where the sun burns behind it. Soft rays fan out into the pale, hazy sky above. The warm light suggests late afternoon.
analysis.subject: sunlit cloud with rays

analysis.description: A dark stone statue of a seated Buddha with closed eyes and folded hands sits on a lotus-shaped base. Tall coconut palms and bright green leaves fill the background in sharp midday light. A few visitors are small and distant at the lower left.
analysis.setting: garden path with palm trees in a park
analysis.subject: Seated Buddha statue among palms

analysis.description: A slice of baked cheesecake topped with sliced strawberries, blackberries and a mint sprig sits on a rustic clay-coloured plate. A swoosh of dark berry sauce curves behind it, and little white cream flowers with dark centres and biscuit crumbs are scattered across the plate. The warm, dim light gives everything an amber glow.
analysis.subject: Cheesecake slice on plated dessert

analysis.description: A young ginger kitten stands beside a rough red-laterite wall, one paw resting on a white pipe lying in the dry leaves. Its amber eyes look straight at the camera with a curious, slightly wary expression. The warm orange fur matches the earthy wall behind it.
analysis.setting: outdoor corner beside a red laterite wall with dry leaves and small weeds
analysis.subject: Ginger kitten on a pipe

analysis.description: A large dark Nandi statue faces a giant black shivalinga while sunbeams fan out from behind a cloud. A golden trident rises in the middle of the frame against the soft evening sky. A few small figures are visible far off near the railings.
analysis.setting: open temple courtyard with large statues at sunset
analysis.subject: Nandi statue and shivalinga at sunset

analysis.description: A richly decorated multi-armed Durga idol stands against a deep red velvet curtain, framed by a bright halo of blue and silver ornamental petals. Long yellow marigold garlands run down the front, with the lion and the green-skinned demon figure at her feet. Offerings and folded saris sit in the lower left corner.
analysis.subject: Goddess Durga idol at a festival pandal

analysis.description: A ground-level firework lights up a dusty patch of earth at night, throwing up a column of smoke and glowing orange sparks. Thin white sparks trail across the ground in curling streaks, with a bright flame glowing at the base.
analysis.subject: fireworks burst on the ground at night

analysis.description: A richly decorated idol of the goddess Durga stands under a golden arch, dressed in red and gold with marigold garlands, her lion and the defeated demon at her feet. Offerings, flowers and a small lit lamp sit on the green-carpeted floor in front, with a blue lattice screen behind.
analysis.subject: Durga idol at festival pandal

analysis.description: A hazy early-morning valley where soft white grass plumes fill the foreground and a narrow stream winds toward the viewer. Layered forested hills fade into pale pink mist, with a few trees and a single utility pole standing among the grass.
analysis.subject: Misty valley with feathery white grass beside a winding stream

analysis.description: A bar wall glows with warm light behind rough, cave-like stone carved with hieroglyphs. Rows of whisky and spirit bottles sit on dark shelves, with stacked glasses along the counter below. A glowing stone lamp on the right and a small figurine add to the theme.
analysis.setting: themed bar interior with Egyptian-style carved stone wall
analysis.subject: backlit bar shelves with Egyptian carvings

analysis.description: Dozens of black stone lingas sit on tiered platforms and brightly painted yellow, orange, blue and green bases inside a whitewashed temple courtyard. A large tree leans in from the left against a soft, hazy evening sky. The colourful miniature shrines and grey stone floor give the frame a quiet, ordered feel.
analysis.setting: temple courtyard with whitewashed wall at dusk
analysis.subject: Rows of black Shiva lingas on painted bases

analysis.description: A close-up of an amber dragonfly clinging to a green plant stem, its large reddish-brown eyes and fuzzy golden thorax sharply in focus. Its translucent, finely veined wings spread across the frame against a soft, blurred background of green leaves and pale grey.
analysis.subject: Dragonfly resting on a green stem

analysis.description: Heavy grey-purple clouds drift across a soft lavender sky, with a warm pink and salmon glow along the bottom edge. The frame is filled entirely with sky, and the cloud edges catch faint light as the day fades.
analysis.subject: dusky clouds at sunset

analysis.description: Two scrub-forest hills slope down to meet in a V, with a hazy pale sky and a soft patch of cloud between them. In the foreground, dry grassland, scattered trees and a strip of red earth fill the valley floor. The light is muted and quiet, like an early morning.
analysis.setting: dry deciduous forest valley with farmland
analysis.subject: Two forested hills meeting in a V

analysis.description: Two bright magenta water lilies rise above dark, lobed lily pads on still water. The left bloom sits low and wide while the right one stands tall on a slender stem.
analysis.subject: two pink water lilies on dark pond leaves

analysis.description: A pale red sun hangs low in a hazy, grey-pink sky above a silhouetted tree line and open farmland. In the foreground, reddish grass plumes and leafy plants sweep across the frame, softening the scene with a quiet, misty glow.
analysis.subject: red sun over hazy fields at dusk

analysis.description: A spotted deer lies on a patch of green grass scattered with dry leaves and twigs, its head turned in profile and one ear raised. A tree trunk sits at the top left of the frame. The soft, even light brings out the white spots on its brown coat.
analysis.setting: shaded forest clearing with grass and fallen leaves
analysis.subject: Resting spotted deer on grass

analysis.description: A tall waterfall spills down a rust-coloured rock cliff in several thin streams, with green trees clinging to the ledge at the top. Looking up from the base, the sky is a small patch of blue at the very top of the frame.
analysis.subject: waterfall cascading down a rock face
